title: How to Properly Recycle Food Scraps
steps: Collect vegetable peels, fruit scraps, leftover food, and bread crumbs.
Separate food scraps from non-compostable waste like plastics and metals.
Use a home compost bin or local composting service for food waste.
Avoid composting meat, dairy, or oily food unless your system supports it.
Composted food scraps turn into nutrient-rich fertilizer for plants and soil.
Educate family and neighbors about reducing food waste through composting.
Spread awareness on preventing food waste and its environmental impact.
precautions: Do not compost meat, dairy, or greasy food in home compost (unless certified for composting).
Store food scraps in a sealed container to prevent odors.
Avoid mixing food scraps with recyclables.
Do not throw food scraps in plastic bags or landfill bins.
